scope: Critical financial flow audit plus bounded MONEY-01 implementation
providers: Mocked in all executed payment tests; no production credentials or funds used
invariants: One principal credit and one ledger entry per top-up despite concurrent completion.
Every returned provider outcome is bound to the exact merchant reference and expected currency.
Flutterwave v3 amount uses fixed major units converted to integer kobo with decimal-string/BigInt arithmetic; overpayments remain explicit evidence.
Missing, pending and unknown processor outcomes remain recoverable; only explicit failed/cancelled/canceled verdicts retire an attempt.
A bounded sweep rotates unresolved rows so one old batch cannot starve later confirmed payments.

implementedIncrement.status: Implemented; focused tests pass; root integration and qualified release review outstanding
changes: Removed expected-amount unit inference. Decimal provider amounts convert exactly once to safe integer kobo.
Rejected missing/foreign merchant reference, missing/foreign currency, absent amount and invalid/sub-kobo amounts. Actual overpayment is preserved.
Bound failed/pending provider outcomes to the expected reference too, preventing a caller-supplied foreign failed transaction ID from retiring an unrelated intent.
Kept not-found/pending top-up and card payment intents recoverable, with review at the former eight-attempt threshold rather than automatic failure.
Rotated global and per-user top-up sweeps using last_reconciled_at.
Guarded unsuccessful reconciliation writes against concurrently completed rows.

before.note: Failures include new behavior reproductions and two error-text assertions; baseline reproduces missing reference/currency/amount accepted, overpayment inference, premature retirement and delayed explicit failure processing.

findings.issue: Company wallet top-up inserts top_ups.currency, which no migration defines, and omits NOT NULL charged_kobo with no default.
findings.trigger: POST /api/company/wallet/topup with any valid positive amount on a fully migrated database produces PostgreSQL 42703 before provider checkout; removing currency alone then produces23502 forcharged_kobo.
findings.fix: Mirror the established customer funding intent/fee fields, validate bounds and checkout method, persist hosted reference; verify isolated real database endpoint.

findings.issue: Company allocation has no durable caller-bound request identity. A browser retry after committed transfer creates a new reference and moves money again.
findings.trigger: Submit the same authorized company-to-member allocation twice or retry after notify/audit failure; each valid call debits the company and credits the member.
findings.fix: Bind a supplied stable key to organization, actor, destination and amount, atomically persist both ledger legs; replay must return the original result and conflicting payload reject. Add same-request10x and20concurrent attempts.

findings.issue: The Paystack simulated verification branch returns paid=true even in NODE_ENV=production and without a configured key.
findings.trigger: Mock/no-network deterministic proof: verifyCheckout(provider:'paystack', reference:'unpaid-legacy-proof', expectedAmountKobo:10000, simulated:true) returns paid:true under production. Customer routes accept simulated from request body for legacy stored provider rows.
findings.fix: Retained legacy provider verification must always call the real verification endpoint; reject simulation in production and reject foreign/missing currency/reference. Add production-mode tests that cannot contact a provider.

findings.status: Fixed in MONEY-01; customer confirm integration remains root-owned
findings.issue: First not-found lookup or eight pending lookups retired a top-up; later webhook only completed pending rows. Browser confirm also treated every non-paid status as failed at customer.routes.js621.
findings.trigger: Bank payment appears at processor after initial lookup or after40minutes of five-minute pending sweeps; wallet stays uncredited.
findings.fix: Retain uncertain intents and use explicit failure classification for cron, on-demand and browser confirmation. MONEY-01 adds10replays,20concurrent completion and queue fairness proofs.

findings.status: Fixed in MONEY-01; qualified human/provider sandbox review outstanding
findings.issue: Expected amount inference confused100-fold overpayment with minor units, and absent tx_ref/currency were fabricated from expected values.
findings.trigger: Expected100NGN while v3 reports10000NGN normalized to10000kobo; response withouttx_ref orcurrency accepted.
findings.fix: Strict v3 fixed-major contract, exact decimal parsing, require reference/currency/amount. Overpayments now stay visible as actual provider evidence; refund owner remains separate.

findings.category: Partner / POS and Admin station approval
findings.issue: Wallet POS station lookup checks organization ownership but does not require an active/open station, unlike direct checkout.
findings.trigger: Partner with paid subscription and verified default bank can publish pricing and submit a valid customer code at a pending or suspended station.
findings.fix: Apply established active/open station acceptance predicate inside the sale transaction and prove rejected station statuses leave wallet/code/ledger unchanged.

findings.issue: Savings multiplies unweighted average unit price by total litres, exaggerating or understating unequal-volume purchases. It also compares historical transactions with mutable current network prices.
findings.trigger: At benchmark1000NGN/L, one litre paid500 and99litres paid1000 yields25000NGN claimed savings instead of500. A later listed-price change rewrites the claimed lifetime savings without a new purchase.
findings.fix: Choose honest product semantics: recorded applied discounts are historical savings; comparison to current network median is only an estimate. Sum per-transaction positive differences with exact numeric arithmetic; do not multiply simple AVGbytotalvolume.

findings.category: Customer / Receipt and Savings, Company / Transactions
findings.issue: New wallet and direct fuel transaction inserts omit unit_price_kobo although savings deliberately excludes rows without it. Direct fuel_orders store a quote but do not propagate it to transactions.
findings.trigger: Every newly recorded ordinary sale is absent from price-based savings; the012migration backfill only repairs rows existing when that migration ran.
findings.fix: Persist the authoritative quote/paid per-unit evidence or derive historical savings from immutable base_amount/amount. Include both wallet and direct checkout sale tests.

findings.issue: Refund reconciliation recognizes successful/completed only; documented completed-mpgs/completed-bank-transfer are left pending forever. It unconditionally calls Flutterwave even for retained Paystack refund rows.
findings.trigger: Provider reports documented successful card refund status completed-mpgs; UIrefund remains pending. A legacyPaystack refund row is queried against thewrongprovider.
findings.fix: Normalize documented provider refund states, correlate exact charge/refund IDs and amount, preserve uncertain outcomes, dispatch by recorded provider. Add provider-specific fixtures and failure/recovery tests.

findings.issue: flutterwaveFetch unwraps response.data, while fetchPaymentPlans subsequently looks for raw.data/raw.meta. A normal API array is interpreted as no plans and pagination metadata is lost.
findings.trigger: Mock standard envelope status:success,data:[plan],meta.page_info.total_pages:2; fetchPaymentPlans returns zero plans and checked:true.
findings.fix: Preserve envelope for paginated endpoints or handle documented array+metadata shape explicitly. Fixture with two nonempty pages and one canceled plan must yield both pages and drift.

findings.issue: A signed Paystack charge.success directly credits completeTopUp without server-side reference/provider/currency/amount verification. Flutterwave correctly re-verifies.
findings.trigger: Authenticated provider event for1kobo with reference of an expected10000kobo pending charge would credit10000kobo; webhook payload amount/status are never checked.
findings.fix: Route by stored provider, verify the transaction server-side, then call the idempotent owner. Duplicate/forged/wrongcurrency/underpayment/delayed replay tests.

findings.status: Root repair pending / provider precision proof blocked
findings.issue: priceWithFee silently rounds every total up to whole naira, including platform-borne fees; accepted100.25NGN produces101NGNcharged and0.75fee. Input andfuel price calculations also use binary multiplication and permit rounding excessive decimal precision.
findings.trigger: priceWithFee(10025) underplatformBearer [redacted] total10100/fee75. Customer and company amounts parsed with Math.round(Number(amount)*100) rather than decimal validation.
findings.fix: Validate integer minorunits/exactdecimal inputs and express fee math in integers. Verify v3 hosted NGN decimal support in provider sandbox before changing external precision policy; if unsupported reject rather than silently surcharge.

findings.issue: Webhook claim is committed before side effects and has no processing/completed distinction. Process death after claim suppresses the provider replay as duplicate. Cron recovers common payment intents, but not every retained provider side effect.
findings.trigger: Terminate a worker afterclaimIdempotency butbeforeeventprocessing; retry receives200duplicate without having completed the original effect. Sudo spend event also only increments card counters, without corresponding wallet/transaction ledger posting.
findings.fix: Define durable event processing/recovery ownership for each supported provider. Do not invent a provider debit/custody model; qualified finance/auth review required before implementing ledger effects.

findings.issue: A failed individual charge can leave the same hosted checkout link open for another attempt. Retiring a top-up checkout reference after one explicit failed charge may strand a later successful retry, because completeTopUp only accepts pending rows.
findings.trigger: First charge under a hosted reference fails; customer retries the same still-open link and pays successfully. Strict verification confirms the later charge but completion rejects the already-failed top-up.
findings.fix: Distinguish charge-attempt failure from checkout-intent terminal failure. Either retain the intent while its hosted session is payable, or allow strictly verified subsequent success to recover failed intent once. Add failed-then-paid, duplicate callback and restart recovery tests.

releaseRequirements.evidence: wallet_ledger is per-wallet single-entry balance history, lacks currency on each posting/counterparty asset-liability postings; company transfer writes two related legs but no balanced journal-level constraint. wallets currency is unconstrained text. Existing reservations/settlements are separate tables.
releaseRequirements.needed: Finance-approved currency/ledger/custody model, reconciliation of provider collections, liabilities, fees, refunds and payouts; immutable audit retention, compensating correction policy, explicit invariant proofs.

Provider sandbox/staging checks for exactNGNprecision, splitfees/merchantfee responsibility, settledbankdestination, duplicate/out-of-order events, refunds, timeoutaftercharge, recovery afterworker/db failure, statement reconciliation and alert delivery.

Qualified review of moneymovement, tenant authorization, sensitive flows; applicable PCI/regulatory assessment from current authoritative advice. Local green tests are not a production readiness certificate.

Adversarial same request10x/20withdrawals, providercharge+dbfailure, crash/restart midprocessing, duplicate/forged/replayed/delayed/outoforder callbacks, finalprovider/ledgeragreement. Existing isolated fuel andsettlement suites prove several narrower cases, not this entire matrix.
